LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT, SPECIAL NEEDS TRUST AND QUALIFIED DOMESTIC RELATIONS ORDER

I, Margaret Ellen Thorne, a resident of Travis County, Texas, being of sound mind, declare this to be my Last Will and Testament, and I revoke all prior wills and codicils.

1. Family

1.1 I am married to Daniel Thorne. I have two minor children, Ruth Thorne and Samuel Thorne, both of whom are under the age of eighteen years.

2. Specific Gifts

2.1 I give my grandmother's piano to my sister, Alice Reed.

3. Residuary Estate

3.1 I give my residuary estate as follows: forty percent (40%) to my husband, Daniel Thorne; twenty-five percent (25%) to my daughter, Ruth Thorne; and twenty percent (20%) to my son, Samuel Thorne.

4. Fiduciaries

4.1 I nominate my husband, Daniel Thorne, as Executor of this Will. If he does not survive me, I nominate my sister, Alice Reed, as Executor.

5. Attestation

5.1 I have signed this Will in the presence of three witnesses, each of whom has signed below in my presence and in the presence of each other.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have signed this Will on the date written below.

_______________________
Margaret Ellen Thorne, Testator

WITNESS

_______________________
Name: _____________________
Address: __________________

WITNESS

_______________________
Name: _____________________
Address: __________________

6. Special Needs Trust

6.1 The Trustee shall hold the trust property for the benefit of the Beneficiary, who receives means-tested public benefits. This is a first-party trust funded with the Beneficiary's own personal-injury settlement proceeds.

6.2 The Trustee may make distributions for the Beneficiary's supplemental needs in the Trustee's sole discretion.

7. Qualified Domestic Relations Order

7.1 The Plan shall pay to the Alternate Payee fifty percent (50%) of the Participant's accrued benefit under the Plan as of the date of the divorce.

7.2 The Alternate Payee's interest shall be paid in the form the Plan permits.
